author: Tim
title: Capybara Cafe Opening With Two Baby Rodents Named Clover And Sweet Pea
text:
The UK is getting its first capybara cafe, and it’s set to open at the end of 2025. It’ll be based in Toftwood, Norfolk, which is about three hours from London.
The Capybara Cafe will start with two baby capybaras named Clover and Sweet Pea. They’re the world’s largest rodents, but they’re closely related to guinea pigs and known for being super chill.
Capybaras usually hang out in big groups and are really sociable, which is part of why owner Jemma Aldridge thought they’d be perfect for something like this. The idea actually came from her kids, who both need extra support and really connected with the animals.
Jemma got an exotic animal license after seeing how much the capybaras helped her children. She said: “I wanted to create something based around the kids, for the kids, that would help other people who are unable to travel to see the capybaras.”
She added: “We want to play on their character and make the space resemble that of their calming, therapeutic outlook. We are very excited to raise them and are hoping there will be a special bond imprinted. The unique and natural friendship they can form with everyone; I can only imagine how much it will help the community.”
The cafe will serve hot drinks and cakes, and it’ll even have a little ‘spa treatment’ experience for the animals. Basically, it’s coffee, cake, and capybaras all in one place.
A similar cafe in Tokyo went viral on TikTok last year, with people saying it was “the best day of my life.” If this one in Toftwood goes well, Jemma might look at expanding it elsewhere in the UK.
